info.title: Hoocon CMS API
info.description: B2B catalog and content API for Hoocon HVAC actuators.

get.description:
Requisites only for a manager-confirmed member.

The company link comes from a free-text name in a lead, so an
unconfirmed visitor sees only the name they typed themselves.
GET /api/account/documents/ — all files of the client card.

GET /api/account/documents/zip/ — все документы клиента одним ZIP (ЛК-8).

Files come from private media only; names are sanitized against
path traversal and de-duplicated inside the archive. The archive is
built in a spooled temp file with a total size cap and its own throttle.
GET /api/account/leads/<id>/ — own lead detail (404 on foreign).

post.description:
POST /api/account/leads/<id>/repeat/ — clone positions into a new RFQ.

Idempotent within a 5-minute window (§9): a repeat of the same source
lead returns the already-created copy instead of spawning duplicates.
GET/POST /api/account/rma/ — reclamations (ЛК-12).
GET/POST /api/account/specs/ — spec templates CRUD (owner scope).
POST /api/account/specs/<id>/to_lead/ — draft an RFQ from a spec.

Record one SPA navigation hit (no marketing consent required).

Unique visitors: existing session key or a daily IP+UA hash — the hit
itself never creates a session. ``title`` / ``object_*`` from the client
are accepted for compatibility and ignored.
POST /api/auth/login/ — mode A password check.
POST /api/auth/logout/ — drop the client session.
POST /api/auth/otp/resend/ — cooldown-gated resend.
POST /api/auth/otp/start/ — mode B: send a fresh 6-digit code.
POST /api/auth/otp/verify/ — mode B: verify the code → session.

POST /api/auth/register/ — mode A step 1: email a confirmation code.

Same response as ``otp/start``; the account is created by
``otp/verify`` once the code proves the email belongs to the visitor.

get.description:
GET /api/catalog/analogs/?brand=&code= — подбор аналога (ЛК-10).

Public, read-only: форма «подобрать аналог» и Excel-импорт спек дергают
один сервис ``catalog.services.analogs_find`` (поле ``analog_belimo_code``).
Ответ — краткая карточка найденного SKU (цены и остатки не отдаём).
List categories with a product preview image per row.

POST /api/integrations/vk/callback/ — VK Callback API (community messages).

Validates ``secret`` in the JSON body against ``VK_CALLBACK_SECRET``.
``confirmation`` events return plain-text ``VK_CALLBACK_CONFIRMATION``;
other events enqueue Celery work and respond with ``ok``.

Handle POST: validate, honeypot check, create, schedule email.

Args:
    request: DRF request with lead payload.

Returns:
    201 with serialized lead (PII-safe: no email/phone in response),
    or 201 silent drop if honeypot is filled (no lead created),
    or 400 on validation errors.

get.description:
OpenApi3 schema for this API. Format can be selected via content negotiation.

- YAML: application/vnd.oai.openapi
- JSON: application/vnd.oai.openapi+json

Handle GET: parse `q`, run hybrid search on all models, paginate.

Args:
    request: DRF request with optional `q` query parameter.

Returns:
    200 with paginated results: {count, next, previous, results,
    corrected_query}. Each result: {type, slug, title, url, snippet}.

Handle GET: return up to ``_SUGGEST_LIMIT`` compact items.

Args:
    request: DRF request with optional `q` query parameter.

Returns:
    200 with {"results": [{type, title, url}]} — empty list for
    queries shorter than ``_SUGGEST_MIN_LEN``.

Return Yandex Metrika / GA4 IDs from SiteSettings with env defaults.

Args:
    request: unused DRF request.

Returns:
    JSON with yandex_metrika_id and ga4_measurement_id (may be empty).

Lead.description:
Serializer for public Lead creation (RFQ / consultation / replacement).

Only client-facing fields are writable; status/timestamps are read-only.
`email` and `phone` are write-only (PII-safe response). `website` is a
honeypot field — the view silently drops submissions where it's filled.
